title: He was destined to learn his own wisdom apart from others or to learn the wisdom of others himself wandering among the snares of the world
html_source: Stephen feels that because he did not fit in with his peers as a child and suffered torment during his college days, he is not meant to lead a life that includes interaction with other human beings.
